title: Copy field
description: A value that exists to be copied: install commands, tokens, links. One click, confirmed in place.
usage: For values the user will paste somewhere else. The button confirms with 'Copied' for a moment — no toast needed for something this small.
a11y: The button keeps a stable aria-label ('Copy value'). The visible label changes to 'Copied', which screen readers announce as the button's name.
